name: AI Usage Meter
description: Shows Claude Code and Codex (ChatGPT) usage in the status bar as a progress bar with a detail tooltip: the 5-hour rolling window and the weekly limit for each, a reset countdown, and a year of your daily activity drawn as a contribution grid. Click a meter to refresh it now. Each meter can be hidden from Settings. Reads your local CLI credentials/sessions/history; the only network call is to Claude's own usage endpoint.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
